name: lan-tools
title: LAN Tools
description: Inventory your home network, read this Mac's connection, and run a pure-HTTP internet speed test.
author: tbrizitsky

preferences.name: showPublicLocation
preferences.title: Show public IP & location
preferences.description: Resolve this Mac's public IP to a location via ipinfo.io (city, region, country, ISP). Turn off to keep the lookup local.
preferences.label: Show public IP & location

commands.name: index
commands.title: My LAN
commands.subtitle: LAN Tools
commands.description: Sweep the network and list all discovered devices with name, IP, MAC, vendor, and advertised services.

commands.name: my-info
commands.title: This Mac
commands.subtitle: LAN Tools
commands.description: Show this Mac's network identity, Wi-Fi RF state, and environment (public IP, DNS, neighbors).

commands.name: speedtest
commands.title: Speed Test
commands.subtitle: LAN Tools
commands.description: Measure internet download, upload, and latency via pure-HTTP providers (Cloudflare default, Yandex).
